seed: The list is closed again with Escape, and the rectangle stays picked while it goes: that is what the sections either side of this walk's Motion check depend on. THE CLAIM: the right hand panel shows the sections that matter, and you can say which. A plain box in a plain document brings Layers, Appearance, Effects and Motion, and none of the job sections: no Measurements, no Layout, no Component, no shelf, because this document is doing none of those jobs. The WORDS on the Sections row at the foot of the panel are read at every stage: just Sections while nobody has hidden anything, Sections and 1 hidden once Motion is off, and just Sections again once it is handed back. A section the document has nothing for yet is not hidden and is never counted. Turning Motion off there takes it away for good, in every document, and the dock is shorter by exactly what Motion cost; Use Automatic For All hands it back in one press and the dock is the height it was, to the point. Then the two things the rule DOES let through: a piece of text, which brings its own section and no more, and a copy of a component in a document that now holds one, which brings Component and the shelf you asked for. Read dockSections back at every stage rather than trusting a picture: the heights are the whole point, and stage 1 against stage 3 is the before and after this walk exists for.

steps.note: BEFORE. A plain box picked in a plain document, everything automatic. Layers, Appearance, Effects and Motion, and none of the job sections: no Measurements, no Layout, no Component and no shelf, because this document holds none of them. The Sections row at the foot reads just Sections, word for word, because nobody has hidden anything: the five sections this document has no job for are not hidden, they are waiting. Read the dock's total against dockViewport: this is the height stage 3 is measured against.

The list the Sections row opens. Every section you are allowed to say no to, each with a word underneath saying why it is where it is: Automatic, or Automatic and not needed in this document yet, or Always shown, or Always hidden. Without that word there is no telling a section you hid from one the document simply has nothing for, and the two want different things from you. This list is the way back to anything the rule left out, and it is one press from anywhere in the panel because the row it opens from sits outside the scroller.

AFTER. Somebody who never animates has turned Motion off, once. THE CLAIM: Escape put the list away and left the rectangle picked, the Motion section is gone, the dock is shorter than stage 1 by exactly what Motion cost, and the Sections row now reads Sections and 1 hidden, which is the only cue that anything is missing and the reason the count is not always printed.
One press hands the lot back. THE CLAIM: Motion is here again and the dock is the height it was at stage 1, to the point. Nothing is lost by turning something off.

A piece of text picked. Its own Text section arrives under the layers list, as the dock's one rule says it must, and nothing else joined it: still no Measurements, no Layout, no Component and no shelf. Picking a different thing changed which section is named after it and nothing else, which is the rule this feature is built on.

A copy of a component, in a document that now holds one. THE CLAIM: Component is here because the document is doing that job, and the Library is here because showing the shelf IS asking for it. Those are the only two sections that arrived across the whole walk, and both arrived because the document changed rather than because the selection did.
